review_type: Single host-authored interactive LotteWorldTower HTML page; content gate only
rubric: 100point fixed quarter-category deductions, summed and rounded once to0.5(midpoints up); independent score/Critical/Warning bands.

findings.problem: SVG drawing annotations use14px before viewBox scaling, below the14pt(approximately19px)review minimum. Main interface text is19px or larger.
findings.action: For a later readability improvement, enlarge informative SVG annotations or provide an enlarged drawing view while avoiding label overlaps.

excluded_scope: All earlier architecture-3d pilot/model-comparison pages, scores and response records. They are not approved for publication by this review.
authorship: Host-authored single page. No claim that an external model authored this deliverable.

validated.public_facts: 555m height and123above-ground floors withKPF/LERA links; other dimensions/structures and site layout explicitly conceptual, not official construction/verified engineering.
validated.workflow: Six selectable explanatory stages; fiveassembly configurations plus finaloverview. Stages5/6intentionally share completedgeometry; screenshot-hash changes are not called proof of different assemblies.
validated.section: Clipping changes live3D exterior/floor visibility; structural blueprints retain their full plan/section geometry.
validated.slab_toggle: Hides123floor slabs; final label accurately limits scope to slabs.
validated.reduced_motion: Automatically clearsrotation, disablescheckbox, exposes explanatory note and leaves manualcamera controls available; settledcamera remains unchanged.
validated.download: Valid self-containedSVG for latest selected122F; filename lotte-concept-floor-122.svg.

environment.performance_claim: Functional review only; no compositorFPS, physicalGPU performance or modelbenchmark scores claimed.

resolved_findings: Core geometry now tapers using the exact same coreWidth(y)profile used by floor-plan and section drawing.
Slab control wording now matches its actual scope.
Reduced-motion auto-rotation control is disabled and explained rather than falsely appearing active.
notes: Only the final label/motion lines differ from the full-tested source; passive renderer inspection and scoped finalrecheck confirmed these changes. The reviewer changed no page/geometry/runtime files.
Only the three approved public files may be deployed under /lotte-tower/. Recopying this review proof does not authorize the abandoned model-comparison pilot.
The remaining annotation-font warning is retained under the fixed PASS band; no mandatory corrective work remains.
